Agent Model

Better name: bayesian_agent? -Could initialize with an SCM that represents the

agent’s internal representation of the world.

-Class could store the trace and perhaps using this

model the predictions based on the SCM.

-This would make the class contain both the agent’s

beliefs and thought processes (how to update beliefs based on new data).

The Bayesian models specified here correspond to how an ideal Bayesian agent would update his beliefs given that he sees one or several observations and receives their predictions that are based on an OLS regression model without intercept.

The agent is considered to have a separate SCM which uses the agent’s (prior or posterior) beliefs to choose the best treatment for a patient.

Technically only one value of X should be allowed after update. -Is there any point of allowing for sampling for other X-values? -The model is NOT VALID for other X values. -Don’t block this (yet), because that would prevent updating with

e.g. 100 patients’ info.

Could be interesting to estimate variance for CATE using sampling as we should expect correlation between E(Y|X,do(A1)) and E(Y|X,do(A0)) but do not know how large that is. This applies to both prior and posterior.

class agent_model.AgentModel(plate_size, prior_parameters=None, scm_constants=None, predictive_var_names=None, low_dim_aux_plate=True, test=False)

Bases: object

get_prior_CATE_mu(A1_fixed, A0_fixed)

The method returns the mean of the CATE-distribution times A1_fixed - A0_fixed. The current SCM is such that N_E is not dependent on X and the treatment effect only depends on N_E and size of A_fixed.

classmethod load_agent_model(file_name='./agent_model', folder='./saved_models/')

Load a saved agent model.

Args: file_name: Base filename without extension (e.g., ‘agent_model’)

Expects to find: - {file_name}.joblib (model configuration) - {file_name}_trace.nc (trace data, optional) - {file_name}_prior_samples.nc (prior sample data, optional)

folder (str): Folder the models are saved in

Returns: AgentModel instance

sample(X_o, pred_o, draws=1000, rng=None)

Sample from the posterior given observed data. Stores latest trace in self.

Args: X_o (np.ndarray): Vector of observed features. pred_o (np.ndarray): Vector of observed predictions. draws (int): Size of sample to draw from the posterior.

sample_posterior_do_A(X, A_fixed, rng=None)

Method for estimating the outcome for a patient with features X based on the agent’s posterior beliefs.

Args: X (np.array): Feature to condition on A_fixed (float): Fixed treatment value rng (int or rng): Random number generator or seed for reproducibility

sample_posterior_predictive(rng=None)

This method generates a sample from the agent’s posterior beliefs. Using the trace stored in self, this method replaces the parameter values in self.predictive_scm and draws a posterior predictive sample from this.

Args: rng (int or rng): Random number generator or seed for reproducibility

Notes: Consider VECTORIZING this method.

sample_posterior_predictive_CATE(X, A1_fixed, A0_fixed, rng=None)

This method returns a sample from the posterior predictive CATE-distribution, and its sample mean and standard deviation.

Args: X (np.array): Feature to condition on A1_fixed (float): Higher dose treatment value A0_fixed (float): Lower dose treatment value rng (int or rng): Random number generator or seed for reproducibility

sample_prior_predictive(draws=1000, rng=None)

Method for sampling from distribution based on the agent’s prior beliefs.

Args: draws (int): Size of sample to draw rng (int): Random number generator or seed for reproducibility

sample_prior_predictive_CATE(X, A1_fixed, A0_fixed, rng=None)

This method returns a sample from the prior CATE-distribution, and its sample mean and standard deviation. Currently CATE is not dependent on X and is hence ATE. It also does not require conditioning on X.

Args: A1_fixed (float): Dosage value of higher dose treatment A0_fixed (float): Dosage value of lower dose treatment X (np.array): Feature to condition on. rng: seed or initialized random number generator for reproducibility

save_agent_model(file_name='agent_model', folder='./saved_models/')

Save the entire agent model (trace + configuration).

Args: file_name (str): Base filename without extension (e.g., ‘agent_model’)

Will create two files: - {file_name}.joblib (model configuration) - {file_name}_trace.nc (trace data) - {file_name}_prior_samples.nc (prior sample data)

folder (str): Folder to save models into.
